newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends down on firmer dlr/yen.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends down on firmer dlr/yen.

text.p: The won closed lower against the dollar on Tuesday, pressured by a stronger dollar versus the Japanese yen in the world market, traders said.
The won stood at 828.20 at the close after opening at an intraday high of 827.30.
The won escaped from a tight range in the afternoon, falling to a low of 828.80 on brisk dollar buying triggered by the dollar's strength against the yen.
However, lack of follow-through dollar buying helped the local unit to recoup some of its losses, traders said.
They said the won was expected to trade in a range of 827.50 to 829.00 on Wednesday. The central bank set the base mid-rate for Wednesday at 828.00, versus 827.40 for Tuesday.
